tools.name: github_workflows
tools.description: Every GitHub Actions workflow a repository has, with whether it is active. Get owner and name from the repository's git remote.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: github_runs
tools.description: Recent workflow runs for a repository, newest first, with their status and conclusion. Narrow by workflow, branch, status, event, actor or commit.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

workflowId.description: Only runs of this workflow. Its id comes from github_workflows.

status.description: Only runs in this state, or with this conclusion.

event.description: Only runs started this way, e.g. push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch.

actor.description: Only runs started by this GitHub login.

headSha.description: Only runs for this commit, which is how a pull request's checks are found. The pull request's headSha comes from github_pulls.

perPage.description: How many runs to return. Default 30.

tools.name: github_run
tools.description: One workflow run with every job in it and each job's steps, which is how to see exactly which step failed.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: github_job_log
tools.description: The end of one job's log, line by line, each with its line number. Use it to read why a job failed: start with the default tail, or grep for the error. Logs age out of GitHub after a while, which the answer says. truncated means earlier lines were left out.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tail.description: How many lines from the end to return, after any grep. Default 200.

grep.description: Only lines containing this text, ignoring case, e.g. error or FAILED.

tools.name: github_annotations
tools.description: What GitHub flagged in one job: the file, line and message behind a failure. Faster than reading the whole log. checkRunId comes from a job in github_run.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: github_artifacts
tools.description: What a workflow run left behind, with each artifact's size and whether it has expired.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: github_pulls
tools.description: Pull requests in a repository, most recently updated first, with their state, branches, review state and size.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: github_pull_files
tools.description: Every file a pull request touches, with its unified diff. Use it to review a change without checking it out.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

tools.name: github_issues
tools.description: Issues in a repository, most recently updated first. Pull requests are left out.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

assignee.description: A GitHub login, or @me for the signed-in account.

tools.name: github_comments
tools.description: What people wrote under a pull request or an issue, oldest first.

owner.description: The user or organisation, e.g. nodelike.

number.description: The pull request or issue number.

tools.name: github_inbox
tools.description: The signed-in account's GitHub notifications: review requests, mentions and assignments, newest first.

all.description: Include ones already read. Default false.
